about: Why the Settings mic meter shows no level (A13.0/A13.2, 2026-11-13). meterHint(reason) = the line under the meter. Reasons: nosignal (the capture failed or is silent: unplugged / in use), blocked (the browser refused the permission; web), unavailable (the meter's noise-filter element is missing; desktop), watching (Pad Watch: no microphone is opened); anything else reads as nosignal. Byte-identical: desktop crates/app/src/testvectors/meterhint.json (owner; meter_hint.rs), web src/features/settings/meterhint.json (meterHint.ts).
